title: Breakthroughs
line: Three pawns against three, and the sacrifice that makes a queen.

steps.text: Three pawns face three, and both kings are far away. One pawn sacrifice breaks the wall, and a white pawn promotes.
Push the middle pawn into Black's pawns.

wrong.h1g2: That loses time: the black king comes over to the pawns, and Black comes out ahead.
wrong.h1h2: That loses time: the black king comes over to the pawns, and Black comes out ahead.
wrong.h1g1: That loses time: the black king comes over to the pawns, and Black comes out ahead.
wrong.a5a6: Black answers by pushing the middle pawn, and the wall holds. Black comes out ahead.
wrong.c5c6: Black takes with the middle pawn, and the wall holds. Black comes out ahead.

steps.hint: Sacrifice the pawn in the middle.
steps.after: Whichever pawn takes, the next sacrifice opens the way.

steps.text: Black took from the side. Now sacrifice the edge pawn too.

wrong.a5b6: That takes back. After the trades, the black king comes and wins your last pawn.
wrong.c5b6: That takes back. After the trades, the black king comes and wins your last pawn.

steps.hint: Push the pawn on the edge.
steps.after: If the pawn on b7 takes, nothing stands in front of your last pawn.

steps.text: The way is open. Run with the pawn.

wrong.c5b6: That takes a pawn, but Black's pawn on the edge runs and promotes.

steps.hint: Push the pawn that has nothing in front of it.
steps.after: The black king is outside its square. The pawn promotes.

summary: Three pawns against three: sacrifice the middle pawn, then a side pawn, and the third one promotes.
